Description: Always 'synthetic' — this dataset is simulated, not real platform records.
Unique id of one donation offered to one organization (e.g. MAT000001).
Donation identifier; one donation is offered to 4–6 candidate organizations.
Organization identifier (fictional organization).
Date the donation was posted. Mixed formats YYYY-MM-DD and DD/MM/YYYY.
Time posted. Mixed formats HH:MM and hh:mm AM/PM.
Weekday of the donation.
Donor business type (from the Kaggle dataset): Restaurant, Supermarket, Cafeteria, Cloud Kitchen.
Fruits, Vegetables, Dairy, Bakery, Meat, Prepared Food. Some values in UPPER CASE.
Units offered (sampled from Kaggle leftover stock). A few impossible values (0 or negative).
Hours until the food's safe-use deadline. ~2% missing, a few impossible 9999 values.
Ambient, Refrigerated or Frozen. Inconsistent spellings (Fridge, CHILLED, Room Temp...). ~2% missing.
Dhaka area of the donor.
Role: dropped (identity/location proxy; distance is used instead)

Description: Fictional organization name.
NGO, Community Kitchen, Shelter, Food Bank, Orphanage. Some lower-case/trailing spaces, ~1% missing.
Dhaka area of the organization.
Whether the organization accepts this food category. Mixed Yes/yes/Y/TRUE.
Whether it has the storage the food needs.
Units the organization can receive per day.
Free capacity at posting time. ~2.5% missing, a few impossible values above daily capacity.
Share of earlier offers the organization completed. ~3% missing, ~1% entered as percentages (e.g. 85.0).
Whether the organization was open when the donation was posted.
Hours until the organization opens (0 if open).
Straight-line distance donor → organization. ~3% missing, some as text '3.4 km', a few negative.
Estimated travel time in Dhaka traffic. ~2% missing.
Organization said yes. Known only AFTER the offer.
Units actually received. Known only after delivery.
Why the match failed. Known only after the outcome.
TARGET: organization accepted AND received the food before expiry. Includes ~2% label noise.
